name: @tangen/toolbar
description: Floating Tangen toolbar for site frontends - page vitals, SDK request timings, console capture and edit-this-page. Optional: install only on sites that want the dev toolbar.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/react.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --packages external --splitting --banner "'use client';" && bun build ./src/global.ts --outfile dist/toolbar.global.js --target browser --format iife --minify && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json
